prompt: List the main components of this repository as JSON {"files": [...]} naming one representative file per component
truth_source: hand-curated by the leaf 1.5.6 bench agent, verified against source at e2740d5a1bd0b4254e517e3af8b60789284bc7bd. Curation rule, stated so it generates this exact key: a component is (a) a top-level src/*.ts module that exports runtime values, or (b) a directory one level under src/ that publishes its own index.ts. Rule (a) enumerates src/*.ts minus the tests and yields compose.ts, context.ts, hono-base.ts, hono.ts, http-exception.ts, request.ts, router.ts and types.ts; src/index.ts is excluded as the package barrel; src/types.ts is INCLUDED because it has one runtime export, `export abstract class FetchEventLike` (35 `export type`, 6 `export interface`, 1 `export abstract class`; a grep for `export const|function|class|let|var|enum` misses the `abstract` form, which is why an earlier version wrongly excluded it). Rule (b) matches exactly three directories - src/client/index.ts, src/jsx/index.ts and src/validator/index.ts (checked with `find src -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name index.ts`); src/adapter/, src/helper/, src/middleware/, src/preset/, src/request/, src/router/ and src/utils/ have no index.ts and are collections of independent opt-in modules, so any single representative would be an arbitrary pick the scorer could not defend. One explicit subtraction from rule (a): src/hono-base.ts is dropped because src/hono.ts is the same component (Hono extends HonoBase) and the prompt asks for one file per component. NOTE: an earlier version of this rule said "top-level modules that src/index.ts re-exports", which was wrong - src/index.ts value-exports only Context and Hono, everything else there is `export type` - and would not have generated this key.
